name: Women's USAF-style mess dress: officer shoulder boards (overlay, blank grade)
size_basis: Same artwork box and scale as garment-mess-dress-female. Board 4.1 in long x 2.2 in wide (silver centre 1.2 in between the 1/2 in braids, enough for a 1 in regular-size form) estimated from DAFI 36-2903 Figs 4.2-4.3; the regulation gives no dimension.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)
documented: officers wear shoulder boards with bullion grade insignia and 1/2 in dark blue braid down each side; women's boards have no button (CAPR 39-1 4.1.2.1.1.1)
placed as close to the shoulder seam as possible
assumed: silver board colour; braid shade 1095 approximated
grade insignia not drawn: placed at rank_slot
